finding.claim: regularExpression() (non-substring mode) accepts any input that starts with a valid representation of the address, because the trailing boundary admits any non-hex, non-colon character including word characters, and the leading lookahead only succeeds at position 0.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled input string passed to addr.regularExpression().test(input) by a consumer that uses it as a validation gate.
finding.sink: Boolean result of RegExp.test used as the validation decision.

trace.note: regularExpression() builds RegExp with substringSearch=false and flag 'i'.
Non-substring branch wraps the pattern in boundary lookaheads.
Leading lookahead (?=^|[^A-Fa-f0-9:]|[^\w:]) inspects the first char of the match; only ^ can succeed for valid addresses, so substring search never matches mid-text.
Trailing lookahead (?=[^\w:]|ADDRESS_BOUNDARY|$) passes for any non-hex, non-colon char, e.g. 'g', ' ', '.', '/'.
ADDRESS_BOUNDARY = [^A-Fa-f0-9:] is the broad alternative that admits word characters; no $ end anchor exists on this path.

finding.guards_checked: No end anchor, no multiline flag, no lookbehind; ^ is the only effective start control; the \w check is shadowed by ADDRESS_BOUNDARY. Not executed: no shell available in this session, confirmed by reading only. Severity medium if used as an allow-list gate, low otherwise.

finding.claim: testBit reads the wrong character index (length - position instead of length - 1 - position), so Teredo flag fields from inspectTeredo() are misreported.
finding.source: Any Teredo address in 2001::/32 passed to Address6.inspectTeredo().
finding.sink: coneNat, reserved, groupIndividual and universalLocal fields of the returned object (ipv6.ts:990-993).

trace.note: flagsBase2 = getBitsBase2(64, 80), 16-char string with index 0 as MSB.
positionInString = length - position; for position 15 of 16 chars this reads index 1, not index 0.

finding.guards_checked: nonce uses slice and is unaffected; testBit is used only on this path. Repro: new Address6('2001:0:4136:e378:8000:63bf:3fff:fdd2').inspectTeredo().coneNat returns false, expected true (flags group 8000). testBit('10',1) returns false, expected true. Low severity: correctness issue with no security boundary inside this library. Not executed: confirmed by reading only.
